answer_1.quote: Visual speech recognition (VSR), also known as lip reading, aims to recognize the content of speech based on lip movements, without relying on the audio stream.

answer_2.quote: The word error rate (WER) is used as the evaluation index of speech recognition, which is defined as W ER = (S + K + I)/N , where S denotes the number of words replaced, K denotes the number of words deleted, I denotes the number of words inserted, and N denotes the total number of words in the reference text.
